advisoryFindings.title: Add representative missing-field cases beyond observed
advisoryFindings.improvement: R5 currently exercises missing `observed`; adding one or two cases for missing `failureMode`, `requirementRef`, or `where` would make the required-field regeneration coverage clearer.
advisoryFindings.whyNonBlocking: The test already proves the retry/regeneration path for an invalid missing required field, so this is coverage depth rather than absent acceptance coverage.
